description: A MINIMUM ground-floor-height clause with a blank operator must not auto-verify as a maximum building-height cap. Family-direction fill (<= for height) plus a stray 'maximum' in a sibling qualifier must not ground the operator. Regression pin for the operator-fill inversion false-verify.

evidence.evidence_text: Subject to the maximum building height, the minimum ground floor height is 3.7 m.

description: A MAXIMUM balcony-projection clause with a blank operator must not auto-verify as a minimum side setback. Family-direction fill (>= for setback) plus a stray 'minimum' in a sibling qualifier must not ground the operator (symmetric inversion).

evidence.evidence_text: Notwithstanding the minimum side yard, the maximum permitted projection of a balcony into a required side yard is 0.6 m.
